[b]SummitONE Sikirsk | 22 March 2025[/b]

(These details are covert and unknown to all except Sikirsk)

With operations underway in the collapsing Armed Republic of Sikirsk, SummitONE Solutions would decide that the time was right to expand on its present available contracts. With Freya Moran's team presently tied down engaging Technocratic forces in the British Republic of Bob, and with Ulf Mayne preoccupied steadily expanding both Seagate Zurekdal and underground factories in Sal-Baliz, SummitONE profits were now at an all-time high without barely even scratching a dent on the current military inventory of company's Corps of Commissionaires.

For as long as money continues to flow into Stormhaven, there shall be new wars to be waged and new investments to be endeavored. At the moment, all eyes were turned towards Sikirsk, supposedly a lawless confederation of business leaders, criminal syndicates, private mercenaries, and hapless citizens torn apart by clashing ideals over the nation's wary future. While the nations of Erene seem to fight for national security and hope, by inspiring and outright supporting those Democratic forces currently pushing against the collapsing Armed Republic, Xavier Almstedt and SummitONE's Board of Directors would have other ideas.

After a few hours of preparation, a communique would be sent to Armed Republic by a certain entity calling itself "Mission Ready Operators (MROS) Dynamics", in reality a SummitONE shell company, which would offer the beleaguered government forces much needed aid in both munitions and training in exchange for partial or direct access to their armament factories and metallurgical plants. Additionally, MROS Dynamics would offer around 3,000 private contractors to safeguard Armed Republic personnel during battle, in government meetings, and other duties.

MROS Dynamics would go on to even offer "worst-case scenario" assessments to the Armed Republic, offering to support their forces with aircraft and a fleet of dark ships with which to not only evacuate key government officials in the event of total government collapse, but also their friends and family, along with any valuable resources like precious jewels, gold bullion, luxury sports cars, and even narcotics. Should the Armed Republic accept these offerings, a contract charging 8 million dollars monthly will be imposed upon its government until the end of the conflict, with the price of the contract open to negotiations.
